title: TMTLTY - Night Vision Helmet
description: A mod that brings a false "night-vision" helmet to the game.
body:
Currently, this mod supports Minecraft 1.21.4 (NeoForge 21.4.137).

![The mod logo.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d1bee8e0e6814f4c69184a9c317b95a0e633558.png)

This is the first mod in the TMTLTY series. The point of these mods is to add features to the game that lie to players so you can trick and troll your friends with them.

This mod adds a Night Vision Helmet to the game, but it actually gives blindness. Combine this with Curse of Binding, and it can be used as a torture device to other players.

Can't convince your friends to wear a helmet? Just give them a False Potion of Night Vision instead!
